rationale: Diagnostic interview observations can identify plausible explanations without establishing how frequently those explanations occur in the population. The mapping supplies no representative sampling or population-frequency estimation basis for these eight interviews. Observing the proposed diagnostic patterns therefore preserves the stated prevalence limitation.
